lyrics.ja: 粧した言の葉で
lyrics.romaji: Kesho Shita Kotonoha de
lyrics.en: With words dressed up in makeup
lyrics.zh: 用粉飾過的話語

lyrics.ja: 誤魔化せる傷ならもう癒えている
lyrics.romaji: Gomakaseru Kizu Nara Mou Iete Iru
lyrics.en: If a wound can be covered up, it's already healed
lyrics.zh: 若能敷衍的傷，早已癒合

lyrics.ja: 有り体に心まで
lyrics.romaji: Aritei ni Kokoro made
lyrics.en: I'm searching for something that plainly
lyrics.zh: 坦率地尋找著

lyrics.ja: 響かせる何かを探している
lyrics.romaji: Hibikaseru Nanika wo Sagashite Iru
lyrics.en: Resonates even to the heart
lyrics.zh: 能讓心也為之震動的事物

lyrics.ja: 酸素を奪い合う群衆と
lyrics.romaji: Sanso wo Ubaiau Gunshuu to
lyrics.en: With the crowd fighting over oxygen
lyrics.zh: 與爭奪氧氣的群眾一起

lyrics.ja: 洋灰の地を這う
lyrics.romaji: Youbai no Chi wo Hau
lyrics.en: Crawling on the concrete ground
lyrics.zh: 在水泥地上爬行

lyrics.ja: 空の空に落ちて 処世の才に
lyrics.romaji: Sora no Sora ni Ochite Shosei no Sai ni
lyrics.en: Falling into the void of voids, starving
lyrics.zh: 墜入空之又空，渴望

lyrics.ja: 餓えた僕を咲ってくれよ
lyrics.romaji: Ueta Boku wo Waratte Kure yo
lyrics.en: For worldly wisdom—laugh at me
lyrics.zh: 處世才能的我，嘲笑我吧

lyrics.ja: 闇い闇に落ちて 無い未来に
lyrics.romaji: Kurai Yami ni Ochite Nai Mirai ni
lyrics.en: Falling into dark darkness, to a future that doesn't exist
lyrics.zh: 墜入深沉的黑暗，對著不存在的未來

lyrics.ja: 嘆いた君に何を贈ろう?
lyrics.romaji: Nageita Kimi ni Nani wo Okurou?
lyrics.en: What should I give to you, who grieved?
lyrics.zh: 該送什麼給嘆息的你呢？

lyrics.ja: この心臓だって僕の意思で動いちゃいない
lyrics.romaji: Kono Shinzou Datte Boku no Ishi de Ugoichai Nai
lyrics.en: Even this heart isn't moving by my will
lyrics.zh: 連這顆心臟也不是憑我的意志在跳動

lyrics.ja: 変えられるだなんて大層な期待しない
lyrics.romaji: Kaerareru Da Nante Taisou na Kitai Shinai
lyrics.en: I don't hold grand expectations that it can be changed
lyrics.zh: 不會抱持能被改變這種誇大的期待

lyrics.ja: 「答えはない」のが答えなのはわかる
lyrics.romaji: 「Kotae ha Nai」 no ga Kotae na no ha Wakaru
lyrics.en: I understand that "there is no answer" is the answer
lyrics.zh: 我明白「沒有答案」就是答案

lyrics.ja: だのに今も求めるのは何故?
lyrics.romaji: Da no ni Ima mo Motomeru no ha Naze?
lyrics.en: So why do I still seek it even now?
lyrics.zh: 可為何如今仍在追尋？

lyrics.ja: 高層ビル 排気ガス 渋滞 交差する人と欲望
lyrics.romaji: Kousou Biru Haikigasu Juutai Kousa Suru Hito to Yokubou
lyrics.en: High-rises, exhaust fumes, traffic jams, people and desires intersecting
lyrics.zh: 高樓大廈、廢氣、塞車，交錯的人與慾望

lyrics.ja: 貧相なストーリー 淘汰 もういっそ梃入れしよう
lyrics.romaji: Hinsou na Sutoorii Touta Mou Isso Teoire Shiyou
lyrics.en: A shabby story, selection—let's just intervene already
lyrics.zh: 寒酸的故事被淘汰，不如乾脆出手干預

lyrics.ja: 構想とは違うが 下んないハッピーエンドよりマシか
lyrics.romaji: Kousou to ha Chigau ga Kudannai Happii Endo yori Mashi ka
lyrics.en: It's different from the plan, but better than a dumb happy ending
lyrics.zh: 雖與構想不同，但總比無聊的快樂結局好吧

lyrics.ja: ああでもなくてこうでもなくて って段々狂ってきている
lyrics.romaji: Aa demo Nakute Kou demo Nakute tte Dandan Kurutte Kite Iru
lyrics.en: Not this way, not that way—I'm gradually going mad
lyrics.zh: 不是那樣也不是這樣，逐漸發狂

lyrics.ja: あー 少しだけ黙っていて
lyrics.romaji: Aa Sukoshi Dake Damatte Ite
lyrics.en: Ah—just be quiet for a little while
lyrics.zh: 啊，稍微安靜一下

lyrics.ja: 空の空に落ちて 本当の解に
lyrics.romaji: Sora no Sora ni Ochite Hontou no Kai ni
lyrics.en: Falling into the void of voids—aren't I living
lyrics.zh: 墜入空之又空，是否

lyrics.ja: 気付けないままに 生きてやしないか?
lyrics.romaji: Kizukenai Mama ni Ikite ya Shinai ka?
lyrics.en: Without ever noticing the real answer?
lyrics.zh: 就這樣未曾察覺真正的解答地活著？

lyrics.ja: 夢の夢に落ちて 劣等故に
lyrics.romaji: Yume no Yume ni Ochite Rettou Yue ni
lyrics.en: Falling into the dream of dreams, because of inferiority
lyrics.zh: 墜入夢中之夢，因自卑

lyrics.ja: 抗う無象だ もがく程溺れるのに
lyrics.romaji: Aragau Muzou Da Mogaku Hodo Oboreru no ni
lyrics.en: I'm a formless resister—the more I struggle, the more I drown
lyrics.zh: 是抵抗的無形之物，越是掙扎越沉溺

lyrics.ja: 本心じゃ希望は捨てちゃいない
lyrics.romaji: Honshin ja Kibou ha Sutechai Nai
lyrics.en: In my true heart, I haven't thrown away hope
lyrics.zh: 真心裡並未捨棄希望

lyrics.ja: でも現実って怪物が視てる
lyrics.romaji: Demo Genjitsu tte Kaibutsu ga Miteru
lyrics.en: But the monster called reality is watching
lyrics.zh: 但名為現實的怪物正注視著

lyrics.ja: 見せてしまえば一斉に囲まれて
lyrics.romaji: Misete Shimaeba Issei ni Kakomarete
lyrics.en: If I show it, I'll be surrounded all at once
lyrics.zh: 一旦暴露，就會被一擁而上包圍

lyrics.ja: 気付きゃもう胃袋の中
lyrics.romaji: Kizukya Mou Iburukuro no Naka
lyrics.en: And before I know it, I'm already in its stomach
lyrics.zh: 回過神來已身陷其胃中

lyrics.ja: 空の空に落ちて 処世の才に
lyrics.romaji: Sora no Sora ni Ochite Shosei no Sai ni
lyrics.en: Falling into the void of voids, starving
lyrics.zh: 墜入空之又空，渴望

lyrics.ja: 餓えた僕を咲ってくれよ
lyrics.romaji: Ueta Boku wo Waratte Kure yo
lyrics.en: For worldly wisdom—laugh at me
lyrics.zh: 處世才能的我，嘲笑我吧

lyrics.ja: 歌を歌って take me down 解を疑って
lyrics.romaji: Uta wo Utatte Take Me Down Kai wo Utagatte
lyrics.en: Sing a song, take me down, doubt the answer
lyrics.zh: 唱著歌，take me down，質疑解答

lyrics.ja: 迷いながらでいい 転がって行こうか
lyrics.romaji: Mayoi Nagara de Ii Korogatte Ikou ka
lyrics.en: It's fine to be lost—shall we tumble onward?
lyrics.zh: 可以迷茫，就這麼跌跌撞撞前行吧

lyrics.ja: もういい 全部ウソってネタばらしの札を出せ
lyrics.romaji: Mou Ii Zenbu Uso tte Netabarashi no Fuda wo Dase
lyrics.en: Enough—reveal the card that says it was all a lie
lyrics.zh: 夠了，攤牌說全都是謊言吧

lyrics.ja: これすらもうきっと誰かの手の上だ
lyrics.romaji: Kore Sura Mou Kitto Dareka no Te no Ue Da
lyrics.en: Even this is surely already in someone's hands
lyrics.zh: 連這一切，想必也已在某人掌中

lyrics.ja: 嘘じゃないだなんて嘘をついたことも
lyrics.romaji: Uso ja Nai Da Nante Uso wo Tsuita Koto mo
lyrics.en: Even having told the lie that "it's not a lie"
lyrics.zh: 連說出「這不是謊言」這般謊言

lyrics.ja: 美しいと思えるんだ
lyrics.romaji: Utsukushii to Omoeru n Da
lyrics.en: I can find beautiful
lyrics.zh: 也覺得很美

lyrics.ja: 空の空を埋めるなら
lyrics.romaji: Sora no Sora wo Umeru Nara
lyrics.en: If I were to fill the void of voids
lyrics.zh: 若要填滿空之又空
